name: Futami Nina
source:
The protagonist of the Liar-S games.

Nina is a 3rd year university student who attends the same university as Sakura and the rest of Liar-S. She is enrolled in an undergraduate foreign languages course. Nina is reserved and meek, being somewhat ignorant in the ways of the world. With a tendency to be swayed by the opinions of those around her, she is easily tricked. As her father is the president of a pharmaceutical supplies company, Nina is belongs to a wealthy and upper class family.

[Translation of [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/dynamic/liar/append.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
